name: Atelier reference

source.reference: Authored editorial reference system for the prompt lab; not a third-party brand or a copy of a proprietary design system

principles: Art-directed restraint: compose like a design-led studio, not an enterprise dashboard.
One hero number, one primary action, one accent.
Warm paper canvas, white document, precise rules, generous whitespace.
Display serif for the amount and brand; system sans for the interface.
Remove explanatory copy; labels, values and consequences carry the screen.
Use an 8px spacing scale and at most six type sizes.
No gradients, glass, neon, emoji, decorative icons or fake window chrome.
Preserve every fact, label, value and consequence from the input data.

rules: Use a warm canvas and a white document; the page is not a dashboard.
The amount is the largest element. The invoice number is a reference, not the hero.
Use two columns at 1280: document left, summary right, 64px gap. Use one column at 390.
Wrap the page in a centered container with max-width 1120px, margin 0 auto and 48px horizontal padding. Use 24px horizontal padding at 390; the summary must never touch the viewport edge.
Use the accent only for the primary action and one small status.
Remove checklists, AI summaries, marketing copy, feature tours and repeated totals.
Keep one enabled primary action visible in the first 800px and at most one quiet secondary link.
Use 14px body text, 11px uppercase labels, and a 72px amount with tabular numerals.
Use spacing and a 1px line, not heavy dividers; one soft shadow on the document.

font.display.value: Iowan Old Style, Palatino, Palatino Linotype, Georgia, serif

components.name: Button
rules: Primary is deep green, 48px high, 8px radius. Only one per screen.
Secondary is a quiet text link or a 1px outline. Do not turn it into a second filled button.

components.name: IconButton
rules: Provide an accessible name and a 44px target.
Only use for familiar actions.

components.name: SegmentedControl
rules: Name the group and expose aria-pressed.
The selected state is a subtle filled surface, not a second primary.

components.name: Poster
rules: Keep title and metadata readable.
Use CSS art, not external images.

components.name: Field
rules: Keep a visible associated label.
Show the error below the field.

components.name: Dialog
rules: Use native dialog.showModal(), Escape dismissal, and restore focus.
Keep the facts and consequence visible.

components.name: Status
rules: Use an 11px uppercase pill and pair color with text.
Use the accent at most once.

components.name: TaskRow
rules: Use a labelled native checkbox.
Retain owner and due date.

components.name: Receipt
rules: Use a white document, 14px radius, a 1px line and one soft shadow.
Use tabular numerals, clear line items and a total. Do not repeat the total in a second summary card.

components.name: PaymentSummary
rules: The amount is a 72px display serif with tabular numerals; it is the hero.
Show supplier, amount, due date, destination and consequence once.
Keep one enabled primary action. Do not add a checklist or a second summary card.

components.name: EmptyState
rules: State what happened and provide one meaningful recovery action.
